preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, the length of array n must be between 3 and 200000.
The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 200000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(m) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{x} {y}' for x, y in operations)
postconditions.description: The output must consist of the number of operations m followed by m pairs of indices x and y.
The number of operations must not exceed n + 5.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] == 1 for i in range(n) if i != index_of_two) and a[index_of_two] == 2
postconditions.description: The array a must consist of n - 1 ones and 1 two after the operations.
